title.zh: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
title.en: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist

current_state.zh: Circle blacklisted and Tether froze a Bitget exploiter wallet holding roughly $318,000 in USDT and USDC, a small fraction of the $351.6 million stolen in Thursday's exchange hack, with most of the funds sitting in unfreezable ETH.
current_state.en: Circle blacklisted and Tether froze a Bitget exploiter wallet holding roughly $318,000 in USDT and USDC, a small fraction of the $351.6 million stolen in Thursday's exchange hack, with most of the funds sitting in unfreezable ETH.
